title: Chapter whereby a person is enabled to go round

verses.t: Chapter whereby a person is enabled to go round, to visit his dwelling in the Netherworld.
I am the Lion-god who issueth from the Bow, and therefore have I shot forth.
I am the Eye of Horus; and the Eye of Horus is opened at the instant that I reach the strand, coming with happy issue.
I advance and, lo! there is no defect found in me, and the Balance is relieved of my case.
